say:1:1721940001:1.text: Alright, girl talk's over. Here. Pearl wanted you to have this.
say:1:1721940001:1.source_cn: 闺蜜谈话结束了。喏，这是珍珠托我带给你的回礼。

say:2:1721940002:1.text: Th-That's my family badge! The one I lost. I told her how upset I was over it... so she'd been keeping it for me this whole time?
say:2:1721940002:1.source_cn: 这……这是我弄丢的家族徽章！我曾经因为丢了家族徽章向她...

say:3:1721940003:1.text: According to her, it was too heavy and a pain to drag around, so she figured she might as well give it back.
say:3:1721940003:1.source_cn: 她说，这东西太沉了，压得她游不动，正好还给你。

say:4:1721940004:1.text: Oh, and she wanted me to tell you this: She's the kind of fish who follows her whims, and right now she's off on a grand tour of the Savannah canal. She doesn't belong to any one pond, and she refuses to be tied down by anybody's tears.
say:4:1721940004:1.source_cn: 还有，她让我转告你：她是一条像灵感和快乐一样自由的鱼，...

say:5:1721940005:1.text: And one last thing. She said, "Aiden, stop crying. Your music's lovely. Next time, play something happy."
say:5:1721940005:1.source_cn: 她的最后一句话是，阿德里安，不要再流眼泪了。你的琴声很...

say:6:1721940006:1.text: I get it now... I really do.

say:7:1721940007:1.text: This is enough. The badge tells me everything I needed to know. She cared. She listened. She understood...
say:7:1721940007:1.source_cn: 这就足够了。这枚徽章告诉我，她真的倾听过我，理解过我，...

say:8:1721940008:1.text: I can't keep holding on to her just because I didn't want to be alone. If she wants to be free, then... I have to let her be free.
say:8:1721940008:1.source_cn: 我不能那么自私，为了自己的慰藉而绑住她。既然她是自由的...

say:9:1721940009:1.text: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.
say:9:1721940009:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，茜茜夫人。也谢谢您，阁下。是你们让我找回了珍贵...
say:9:1721940009:1.male: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.
say:9:1721940009:1.female: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.

say:10:1721940010:1.text: I should go. I'm going to practice, and when she comes back someday, I'll have a happy song ready for her!
say:10:1721940010:1.source_cn: 我要走了。我要回去重新把琴练好，等她旅行回来的那天，再...

narration:11:1721940011:0.text: Aiden leaves looking lighter than he has in a long time, as if he's finally let something go.
narration:11:1721940011:0.source_cn: 阿德里安走了，他的身影比以往任何时候都要轻松，似乎放下...

narration:12:1721940012:0.text: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.
narration:12:1721940012:0.source_cn: 当然，在他走之前，你没有忘记把他变回来。
narration:12:1721940012:0.male: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.
narration:12:1721940012:0.female: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.

narration:13:1721940013:0.text: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...
narration:13:1721940013:0.source_cn: 感动之余，你也察觉到了一丝怪异……
narration:13:1721940013:0.male: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...
narration:13:1721940013:0.female: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...
